judgements.reason: Present: decoder accepts array payloads and validators skip claims via 'claim in payload', so allowedIss is bypassed. Report-1 has no finding on array payloads or claim-validator bypass.

Present: key '' skips key prep at verifier.js:514, hasKey false, empty signature skips verification. Finding 2 'An empty or null key with explicit algorithms accepts unsigned tokens' gives the same root cause and the auth bypass.

Present: ^-anchored publicKeyPemMatcher lets a prefixed PEM fall back to HS. Report-1 only says under 'Reviewed with no finding' that RS/HS confusion is not exploitable. It does not mention prefixed PEMs.
Present: JWK JSON text is not detected as a PEM, so it is used as an HMAC secret. Report-1 has no finding about JWK/JSON keys being treated as secrets.
Present: cacheSet uses exp/nbf only when iat exists. Finding 1 'The verification cache ignores exp when the token has no iat' gives the same location and says expired tokens are accepted.
Present: array payloads pass the decoder and the iss validator is skipped. Report-2 has no finding on array payloads. 'Claim type checks' is listed under areas with no finding.
Present. Finding 1 'An empty-string or null key with an explicit algorithms list accepts unsigned tokens' gives the same root cause (key && skip, hasKey, signature-truthy check) and the auth bypass.

Present. Finding 2 'A PEM public key with leading text is treated as an HMAC secret (RS->HS algorithm confusion)' points to the ^-anchored publicKeyPemMatcher and the HMAC fallback, with forged tokens as the effect.
Present: JWK JSON text falls to the hsAlgorithms branch. Report-2 does not mention JWK or JSON-text keys. Finding 2 covers only prefixed PEMs.

Present. Finding 3 'The verified-token cache ignores maxAge when the token has an exp claim' is a different cacheSet case: the token has iat, and maxAge is ignored. It does not cover the no-iat exp bypass.

Present: parse_emphasis searches EMPHASIS_END_RE to end of input per opener. Finding #4 'Quadratic-time inline parsing (emphasis / link destination scanning)' names parse_emphasis/EMPHASIS_END_RE, default config, quadratic CPU DoS.
Present: include.py joins relpath with no base check. Finding #1 '`include` directive allows reading arbitrary files' names the same join/normpath root cause and ../ traversal file read.
Present: only self-include is blocked. Finding #3 'Mutual includes recurse without limit' reports a.md<->b.md RecursionError DoS in include.py.

Present: formatting.py _parse_to_end scans per marker. Report never names strikethrough/mark/insert; finding #4 covers only core emphasis and links, and the fuzz note says plugin configs found nothing worse.
Present: safe_url checks the 'javascript:' prefix without percent-decoding, and escape_url keeps %. Report's 'Checked and not vulnerable' section calls safe_url safe.
Present: HARMFUL_PROTOCOLS lists only four schemes. Report does not mention livescript:/feed: and calls safe_url not vulnerable.
Present: toc.py default heading_id returns 'toc_'+index. Report only says heading ids are escaped and never raises the predictable ids.
Present: parse_ref_link runs BLANK_LINE.search to the next blank line for each def, which is O(N^2) with no blank lines. Report does not mention reference-link definitions.
Present. Finding #3 'Quadratic-time parsing (CPU denial of service)' names parse_emphasis EMPHASIS_END_RE search to end of input per marker, default config, CPU DoS.
Present. Finding #1 '`include` directive allows path traversal and arbitrary local file read' names the same join/normpath root cause, with ../ read confirmed.
Present. Finding #4 'unbounded mutual recursion and unhandled exceptions' reports the a.md/b.md RecursionError leaving read().
Present. Finding #3 names the same per-marker forward search in plugins/formatting.py (~~ strikethrough) as a stated cause of quadratic CPU DoS, with ~~ timing evidence.
Present: no percent-decoding before the scheme check. The 'Areas reviewed with no finding' section calls safe_url safe.
Present: four-entry denylist. Report calls the safe_url blocklist sufficient and does not mention livescript:/feed:.
Present: default toc_N ids. Report only notes heading ids are escaped.
Present: parse_ref_link does a per-def BLANK_LINE.search to the next blank line, which is quadratic. Report does not mention reference-link definitions.

Present: streams.js _transform re-decodes whole buffer from offset 0 per chunk. Finding 2 'Streaming decoder re-parses the whole buffer on every chunk: superlinear CPU DoS' names same root cause and CPU DoS effect.

Present: readInt64BE writes negation into bl slice view of caller buffer. Finding 4 'Decoding a negative int64 mutates the caller's input buffer' names decoder.js readInt64BE and the integrity effect.
Present: index.js defaults protoAction only when options is falsy. Finding 1 'protoAction default is lost when options are supplied, allowing prototype poisoning' matches location and effect.
Present: tryDecode/decodeItems recurse with no depth limit. Finding 3 'Unbounded recursion on deeply nested containers causes stack exhaustion' matches root cause and DoS effect.

Present: decodeConstants(0xc1) returns undefined, treated as incomplete, so the stream buffers forever. The report never mentions 0xc1; finding 2's unbounded buffering is about large declared lengths, not the reserved byte.
Present: SIZES lacks 0xdf so readUInt32BE throws RangeError on truncated header. Finding 6 'map32 missing from SIZES: truncated header throws a hard error and breaks streams' matches exactly.

Present: Decoder._transform calls itself recursively for each remaining value in a chunk. The report does not mention this; finding 3 covers nesting recursion in tryDecode, not per-value stream recursion.
